claim: Coca-Cola's fiscal third quarter of 2023 revenue was $12 million.
summary: Coca-Cola's fiscal Q3 2023 (quarter ended September 2023) revenue was approximately $11.95 billion (~$12 billion), not $12 million. The $12 million figure is ~1,000x too low and inconsistent with Coca-Cola's well-established scale of ~$45-46 billion annual revenue in 2023.

sub_claims.text: Coca-Cola's fiscal third quarter of 2023 revenue was $12 million
sub_claims.note: No tool evidence available per instructions; judgment based on model knowledge. Coca-Cola quarterly revenue is on the order of $11-12 billion in 2023, with Q3 2023 reported at ~$11.95 billion, so $12 million is contradicted by three orders of magnitude (likely a million/billion unit error).
